summary: Iteration 31 — validated the three additive enhancements: (1) Refunds Method Filter, (2) Hosted Checkout Method Filter, (3) Provider Uptime sparkline. All backend and frontend tests passed (18/18 UI + 2/2 API).
critical_code_review_comments: Providers.jsx: the 15s setInterval re-check will grow the uptime history unbounded (capped by slice(-16), so OK visually). Sparkline count and 'X/Y' will also drift over long sessions — expected per spec (SESSION-scoped, resets on reload).

Refunds provider_key resolution in payments router uses a JOIN Payment for each refund — currently returned via a single SELECT + zip, which is fine for scale; keep the ORM eager select for future N+1 protection if list_refunds ever loads related refund objects individually.

MethodBadge derivation is a client-side heuristic (provider_key === 'demo_upi' ? UPI : Card). If a future UPI provider (e.g. razorpay-upi) is added, the badge will misclassify — consider centralising method inference on the backend or via payment_method field.
